name: 2008 Financial Crisis
blurb: Lehman Brothers collapses and banks need a government rescue.
news: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are placed under government control.
Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy. Bank of America agrees to buy Merrill Lynch.
The Federal Reserve announces an $85 billion rescue loan for AIG.
Regulators seize Washington Mutual and sell its banking business to JPMorgan Chase.
The House rejects the $700 billion bailout bill. The Dow falls 778 points.
Congress passes the bailout (TARP) and President Bush signs it.
The Dow jumps 936 points, its biggest point gain ever at the time.
The government announces a rescue package for Citigroup.
The Federal Reserve cuts interest rates to nearly zero.

name: Dot-com Bust
blurb: Internet stocks hit record highs, then the bubble bursts.
news: The Nasdaq closes at a record high above 5,000.
A judge rules that Microsoft broke antitrust law. The Nasdaq drops sharply.
The Nasdaq falls almost 10% in a single day.
A judge orders Microsoft to be split into two companies.
The presidential election ends without a clear winner.
The Supreme Court's Bush v. Gore decision settles the election.

name: COVID Crash
blurb: A pandemic shuts down travel, then stimulus sparks a fast rebound.
news: The Dow falls more than 1,000 points as the virus spreads outside China.
The Federal Reserve makes an emergency half-point rate cut.
An oil price war begins. A circuit breaker halts trading for 15 minutes.
The World Health Organization declares a pandemic.
The Fed cuts rates to nearly zero. The Dow has its worst day since 1987.
The Fed announces unlimited bond buying.
The $2 trillion CARES Act stimulus is signed into law.
US oil futures fall below zero for the first time.
Moderna reports encouraging early results from its vaccine trial.
The jobs report surprises with 2.5 million jobs added in May.

name: Meme Stock Squeeze
blurb: Online traders pile into GameStop and squeeze short sellers.
news: GameStop adds Chewy co-founder Ryan Cohen to its board.
GameStop and AMC become the most talked-about stocks on Reddit.
The frenzy spreads: AMC, Koss and BlackBerry soar alongside GameStop.
Robinhood and other brokers stop customers from buying GameStop and AMC.
GameStop shares collapse as the squeeze unwinds.
Congress holds a hearing with the CEOs of Robinhood, Citadel and Reddit.

name: 2022 Rate Hikes
blurb: Inflation climbs and the Fed raises rates faster than in decades.
news: Meta falls 26% after reporting its first drop in daily users.
Russia invades Ukraine. Oil prices surge.
The Fed raises interest rates for the first time since 2018.
Netflix falls 35% after losing subscribers.
The Fed raises rates by half a point, the most since 2000.
Crypto prices crash after the TerraUSD stablecoin collapses.
The S&P 500 enters a bear market.
The Fed raises rates by 0.75 points, the most since 1994.
Inflation comes in higher than expected. The S&P 500 drops 4.3%.
